description: This file implements a SOAP web service interface for various CRM operations such as creating leads, contacts, accounts, tickets, and other entities. It registers multiple SOAP methods, handles user session validation, permissions checks, and interacts with CRM modules to perform CRUD operations. Additionally, it provides functions for user login, permission checks, and retrieving picklist values.

classes.name: soap_server
classes.description: A class from the included nusoap library used to handle SOAP web service operations.

methods.name: CheckLeadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit leads based on session validation and user role permissions.

methods.name: CheckContactPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit contacts.

methods.name: CheckAccountPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit accounts.

methods.name: CheckTicketPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit helpdesk tickets.

methods.name: CheckVendorPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit vendor records.

methods.name: CheckProductPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit product records.

methods.name: CheckNotePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit documents/notes.

methods.name: CheckSitePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit portal/sites.

methods.name: CheckRssPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit RSS feeds.

methods.name: create_site_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new portal/site entry based on web form input if the user has permission.

methods.name: LogintoVtigerCRM
methods.description: Authenticates a user and creates a session token if credentials are valid.

methods.name: create_rss_from_webform
methods.description: Creates and saves a new RSS feed URL if the user has permission.

methods.name: create_note_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new document/note in the CRM from web form data.

methods.name: create_product_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new product record from web form input.

methods.name: create_vendor_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new vendor record from web form input.

methods.name: create_ticket_from_toolbar
methods.description: Creates a new HelpDesk ticket with given parameters if the user has permissions.

methods.name: create_account
methods.description: Creates a new account record in CRM after session validation and permission check.

methods.name: create_lead_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a new lead record from web form submission.

methods.name: create_contacts
methods.description: Creates a new contact record and a helper function create_contact1 with detailed parameters.

methods.name: GetPicklistValues
methods.description: Returns picklist (dropdown) field values for a specified table, depending on user permissions.

methods.name: validateSession
methods.description: Checks if a user's session ID matches the stored session ID in the database.

methods.name: getServerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID for a user from the database.

methods.name: unsetServerSessionId
methods.description: Removes the session ID from the database for the given user ID.
